verdict.rationale: The Division documents its own way to track a submitted work order: on the Contact Us page you enter your contact details and pick "Work Request Status" from a drop-down. It also offers alerts when filings are added to the public record, and UCC status reports. However, the tracking runs through a contact form rather than a self-serve status page, and nothing shows what status detail it returns. missing for 10: a direct public lookup by filing or application number, documented status states and turnaround, coverage for applications such as tax registration or certifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.
